notes: Not a repo of its own: drawn from the production Abber customer app, local checkout /Users/ar/Development/projects/abber-project/Abber-App (v11.0.12+449), read-only; redrawn from code, not a live screenshot. Flow shown is the shared PaymentView with its DefaultPaymentHeader (the shell used by store/bill/resume payments; title 'وسيلة الدفع'), light theme, RTL. Colours, text scale, radii from lib/core/themes; font = the app's ReadexPro; icons = the real Solar linear/bold icon font (solar_community_icons 1.3.0, local copy) with codepoints from its Dart constants. Brand marks are only the app's own bundled assets shown by the code: assets/svgs/apple.svg, visa.svg, mada.svg, master.svg and assets/pngs/tamara.png. Sample data only: amount 149.00, wallet balance 35.00, and the two saved cards, which are obvious test cards shown masked exactly as the code prints them (Visa •••• 1111, mada •••• 0007); CVV '123' is a placeholder (the field is not obscured in the code, and the keyboard closes after the third digit). Fidelity doubts: (1) which methods appear and their order is decided by the server (active_payment_methods), so the set shown here is one plausible configuration; (2) the catalog line mentions STC Pay and HyperPay: the current app code has no STC Pay row in the method list (only an stc.svg asset and a legacy BrandImageWidget branch) and HyperPay is the card gateway behind the card rows with no logo of its own, so neither name appears on screen; (3) brand logos inside list rows are sized by the 32px logo slot as the layout code implies (computed, not measured on a device); (4) modal barrier opacity uses Flutter's default black54.
